title: Erased TypeScript text still affects minified identifier names
author: atarutin
body_preview: With `minify`, esbuild orders its minified-name alphabet by the character frequency of the input text. Comments (#543) and import paths (#1846) are already left out of that count. Erased TypeScript isn't: type aliases, interfaces and type annotations still count. So an edit that only touches types changes the minified names in the output, even though every emitted statement is the same.  **Repro**...
